Overview

Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Energy & Utilities earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from SCADA / EMS cores and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. For Energy & Utilities, the design tension is specific — grid state on one side, NERC CIP standards on the other, and a control environment that must survive both internal audit and external inspection. We build for that tension explicitly rather than discovering it at gate review.
